events.verdict: Coffey (LAC) establishes himself in Dort's (OKC) path and absorbs the marginal contact as both players come together during the pick.
Williams (OKC) legally contests Powell's (LAC) layup attempt.
Powell (LAC) deflects the pass out of bounds.

Replay review of the foul called on Powell (LAC) pursuant to a coach's challenge was deemed unsuccessful. Powell wraps Joe (OKC) with both hands and affects Joe's FOM during the throw-in. The illegal contact occurs prior to the release of the throw-in and an away-from-the-play foul is correctly assessed.
Dunn (LAC) and Harden (LAC) both avoid making any illegal contact with Joe's (OKC) arms.
Coffey (LAC) maintains a legal guarding position during Williams' (OKC) drive to the basket and shot attempt.
Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC) cleanly dislodges the ball from Coffey (LAC) and is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Williams (OKC) pulls Zubac's (LAC) hand off of the ball, affecting his shot attempt at the basket.
Coffey's (LAC) arm is not in a legal vertical position when he initiates contact with Gilgeous-Alexander's (OKC) arm, affecting the jump shot attempt.

Dort (OKC) reaches in, but Harden (LAC) grabs his arm and immediately releases to initiate the marginal contact between the two players. Harden then loses his balance on his own and Dort gets his hand on the ball before a held ball is correctly whistled.
Zubac (LAC) makes clean contact with the ball as he attempts to steal the ball from Wallace (OKC).
